limitations: The source caller must supply one participant's ESM rows and the corresponding sensing offset rows; participant association is not inferred.
The executable code uses strict open bounds and minutes(30), although its adjacent comment says plus-or-minus 30 seconds.
The source mode ignores NA offsets and resolves a frequency tie to the first distinct nonmissing value in filtered sensing source order.
Unsupported timestamp spellings and offsets that cannot be represented exactly as nanoseconds fail closed instead of invoking lubridate's heuristic parsing.
This component stops after ESM timestamp correction, weekday labeling, and chronological numbering.
